studio.privacy.contactLine: Write to us if you have a question about your data.
studio.privacy.cookiesLine: One cookie keeps you signed in. Your browser also remembers small preferences, such as your theme and which studios you have opened. Analytics cookies show us which pages and tools people use, so we can make them better. There are no advertising cookies.
studio.privacy.deletePost: → Delete account removes your account, your runs, your files and your GPU connection at once.
studio.privacy.gpuLine: When you connect your own GPU, your runs go to it from Fuobe, and the results come back to your account.
studio.privacy.howLongLine: Uploads are deleted after 14 days. Your runs and what they made are deleted after 30 days, so download anything you want to keep.
studio.privacy.keptLine: Your email address, and a protected form of your password: the password itself is never stored. The pictures, clips and sound you upload, and everything you make. The address of the GPU you connect, so your runs can reach it.
studio.privacy.keysLine: Provider keys are encrypted at rest and never sent to a third party.
studio.privacy.lead: What Fuobe keeps when you use it, for how long, and how to remove it.
studio.privacy.openLine: Fuobe is open source, so you can read exactly how it handles your data
studio.privacy.runsLine: Prompts and settings are kept so you can reuse them; results stay until you delete them.
studio.privacy.shareLine: When you make a share link, anyone who has that link can see what it shares.
studio.privacy.title: Privacy
studio.privacy.uploadsLine: Files you upload stay on your account's storage until you delete them.
studio.privacy.whoLine: Fuobe is an open-source studio run by a small team. No ad network, no data broker.
studio.privacy.whoSeeLine: The Fuobe team can see what you upload and make, to keep the service working and safe. We don't sell your data, and we don't show it to anyone else.
studio.privacy.yourRightsLine: Export or delete your data at any time from Settings.

assist.askTipOn: You approve each plan (and each memory) before anything runs
assist.askTipOff: Plans run right away — no approval card
assist.hint.claude: Claude plans the shoot, picks models and runs them with your approval.
assist.hint.hosted: Runs on a model from a provider you've connected (Settings → AI helper). It plans the shoot, picks models and runs them with your approval.
assist.hint.local: Runs on your local model (Ollama, LM Studio or Unsloth Studio). Smaller local models follow instructions less reliably than Claude.
assist.hint.offline: A simple rule-based planner. Add a key in Settings → AI helper (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter…), or run a local model (Ollama, LM Studio or Unsloth Studio), for the full assistant that picks models, chains steps and checks results.
assist.scheduleTip: Run this chat's request again on a schedule
assist.saveSkillTip: Turn what ran in this chat into a skill you can run again with new inputs
assist.describe: Describe the whole job. Assist picks the models, shows you the plan and cost, then runs every step. Type / to use a skill.
assist.placeholder: e.g. “A launch campaign for my sneaker: 3 hero stills, then a 5s vertical video of the best one”
assist.placeholderWaiting: Or tell me what to change…
assist.placeholderAsk: Ask for changes, variations or the next step…
assist.suggest0: A 3-shot ad for a gold watch on a model's wrist on a Lake Como terrace — hero still, then animate it
assist.suggest1: Four moody portraits of a model in a black velvet suit, 35mm film, then pick the best and animate it
assist.suggest2: Storyboard a 6-frame escape from a Venice masquerade ball at midnight
assist.suggest3: A 10-second vertical video of a model in a red silk gown running through falling snow at night, with sound
canvas.title: Canvas
canvas.heroLine: Make images, videos and ideas in one place: wire prompts, files and models together, then run them in order or side by side.
canvas.whatsBody: A board of connected steps: a photo goes in, an edit sets the scene, and the last step turns it into a moving shot. Change any step and run it again.
canvas.readyBoardNoteOwner: Every step, word and file is already in place. Press Run all, or change anything first.
canvas.readyBoardNoteVisitor: Every step, word and photo is already in place. Open one in the editor and change anything.
canvas.skillsNote: Open a skill that runs by itself as a canvas, change a model or a link, then save it back as a skill.
canvas.renameDesc: Give this canvas a new name
canvas.deleteDesc: The board is removed for good. Everything it made stays in your library.
canvas.moreNote: Boards to build on, and a blank one.
mae.metaDesc: Camera moves a film crew would make and cinematic effects, ready for any photo.
mae.showcaseLabel: The best camera motions and effects
mae.motionsLine: Moves a film crew would make: orbits, drone dives, crash zooms. Mix any two.
mae.effectsLine: Add one photo and get the shot: storms, blooms, flares, floods.
nav.image.line: Describe it and get a picture, from a portrait to a poster.
nav.video.line: Turn words or a still into a moving shot.
nav.edit.line: Change a picture with a sentence. The rest stays.
nav.live-edit.line: Type a change and watch the picture follow.
nav.inpaint.line: Paint over one part and say what goes there.
nav.layers.line: Split a picture into layers you can move and swap.
nav.color-grade.line: Grade a shot, or match the colors of another.
nav.canvas.line: Wire models together into a flow you can run again.
nav.storyboard.line: Plan a film frame by frame, then shoot each frame.
nav.extend.line: Make a clip longer, picking up where it ends.
nav.reframe.line: Any shape from any shot: vertical, square or wide.
nav.video-edit.line: Restyle a clip with words and keep its motion.
nav.katana.line: Cut your clips into a story on a timeline.
nav.video-tools.line: Trim, join, matte and caption any clip.
nav.shorts.line: Vertical reels from one idea, ready to post.
nav.faceless.line: A whole channel of episodes, with no face on camera.
nav.content-factory.line: A series of posts and clips from one brief.
nav.lipsync.line: Make a photo talk, sing or present in any voice.
nav.explainer.line: Turn slides or a document into a narrated video.
nav.virality.line: Score the first three seconds before you post.
nav.ads.line: One campaign in every size and format.
nav.moodboards.line: Lock a look from references and reuse it anywhere.
nav.photodump.line: A whole photo pack of one person, in any setting.
nav.fashion-factory.line: Outfits, try-ons and lookbooks on real-looking models.
nav.influencer.line: Build a character with a face that stays the same.
nav.character-sheet.line: One face from every angle, ready for any shot.
nav.elements.line: Save your people, places and props to use anywhere.
nav.upscale.line: Make pictures and clips sharper and larger.
nav.audio-clean.line: Remove noise and echo from any voice.
nav.audio-translate.line: Your video, dubbed into another language.
nav.audio-sfx.line: Any sound effect from a few words.
nav.audio-music.line: A track from a few words, in any mood.
nav.any-angle.line: See the same subject from any angle you choose.
nav.cinema.line: Direct a film shot by shot: camera, lens, light and {moves} moves.
nav.marketing.line: From a product link to a finished ad. {templates} ad templates.
nav.mixed-media.line: Redraw a clip as collage, paper or paint, in {looks} looks.
nav.genjutsu.line: Keep a clip’s motion. Change what’s in it.
nav.character-swap.line: Put your character into whole clips, shot by shot.
nav.motion-control.line: Give anyone the moves from any clip.
nav.audio.line: Voices, music and sound for any clip, made or split apart.
nav.image-to-3d.line: A photo or a sentence to a 3D model you can spin.
nav.kinetic.line: Motion graphics in your brand: titles, offers and end cards.
